summary_en: This study tests three drugs given together: pembrolizumab, ibrutinib and rituximab (or a biosimilar), in people with refractory or relapsed primary central nervous system lymphoma. Pembrolizumab is given by IV every 3 weeks, rituximab by IV once a week for 4 weeks, and ibrutinib by mouth at 560 mg or 840 mg, with the record listing its frequency as both daily and twice daily. The record does not state the main outcome; it is a Phase 1b/2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa tres medicamentos administrados juntos: pembrolizumab, ibrutinib y rituximab (o un biosimilar), en personas con linfoma primario del sistema nervioso central refractario o recidivante. El pembrolizumab se administra por vía intravenosa cada 3 semanas, el rituximab por vía intravenosa una vez por semana durante 4 semanas, y el ibrutinib por vía oral en dosis de 560 mg o 840 mg, aunque el registro indica su frecuencia como diaria en una parte y dos veces al día en otra. El registro no indica el resultado principal; es un estudio de Fase 1b/2.
who_for: Pathologically confirmed primary CNS lymphoma that progressed after CNS therapy, is refractory, or has relapsed.
Evidence of disease on brain MRI or CSF cytology; ocular-only recurrence is allowed.
Life expectancy greater than 3 months, in the investigator's opinion.
not_for: Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, or other T-cell co-inhibitory or stimulatory receptor agent.
Previously progressed on ibrutinib or another BTK inhibitor.
Intracranial hemorrhage greater than Grade 2, or arterial thromboembolic event within 3 months.
Active autoimmune disease needing immunosuppressants or steroids above set limits.
